title: Implement segment tree for range sum queries in Go
description: Greenfield Go task: implement a segment tree supporting range sum queries and point updates in O(log n) time.

required_artifacts: build recursively constructs sum segment tree
Query handles single-element, full-range, and partial-range correctly
Update propagates new value up the tree
tree is 1-indexed with root at node 1
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
